x: During the Ajnatavasa at Virata's court Yudhishthira lived as the Brahmin Kanka; Tantripala was Sahadeva's name and Arishtanemi Sahadeva's other alias, so Kanka is the answer.

from_notes: Dravidian family; sub-branch South-Central Dravidian

from_notes: What was the official language of Andhra Pradesh-Telugu, referred by the British? Italian of the East

from_notes: Urdu = second official language in all districts since the 2022 amendment

from_notes: Adikavi, Vaganusasana
